review.finding: Project scope: realPathGuard uses JS realpathSync (keeps input casing/8.3 names) while safe-read compares against native fs.promises.realpath; a lowercase drive letter, a root registered in different case or a wrongly-cased filename gets ok from decide() and then 400 not_a_file from the route. Fails closed but regresses parity with /projects/:id/file.
review.suggestion: After realPathGuard run native realpath, re-check against realRoot, serve the canonical path; add a route-level test.

review.finding: Project-scope credential denylist ran on the non-canonical string: 8.3 names (SSH~1), trailing dot/space, ADS spellings pass isSensitivePath inside decide(); only safe-read's realpath===p check stopped them. Session scope already re-checks on the native realpath.
review.suggestion: Run isSensitivePath on the native canonical relative path; add tests for .ssh. and .SSH.

review.finding: Existence oracle: through a link inside the project, 404 vs 400 reveals whether files exist under the out-of-project target (also dangling links).
review.suggestion: 404 only when lstat of the lexical in-project path is ENOENT; any hop resolving outside the root always answers 400 symlink_escape.

review.finding: PROJECT_DIRS omits .git so project/.git/config (may carry tokens) is served in project scope.
review.suggestion: Add .git/config rule to project scope or document the parity decision.

review.finding: Evidence scan queue: timeout does not cancel the scan and the queue is unbounded; client-chosen short basename defeats the pre-filter, so N requests cost N full scans.
review.suggestion: Cap pending depth and answer 429/503; abort timed-out scans.

review.finding: File-symlink tests return silently when privilege is missing; dangling and final-component swap not executed on this host.
review.suggestion: Use junction to a removed dir for dangling; it.skipIf(!canSymlink) for file links.

review.finding: findSessionEvidence contract JSDoc sits on EvidenceResult; routes.ts status list omits 403 sensitive_location.
review.suggestion: Move the doc, extend the table.

notes: No reproducible read outside project or evidence scope was found. Sibling-prefix, other-drive, UNC/device, drive-relative input never get project scope; session scope checks sensitivity and evidence on the native realpath.
